hoy.titular: Six days from Montevideo, the Pincha return to City Bell tomorrow for the final week

foto.alt: Estudiantes' coaching staff talk during a training session in City Bell.

hoy.resumen: After Sunday off, the squad return to training on Monday in City Bell and travel to Montevideo on Wednesday. Medina sounded confident in an interview with CONMEBOL, while at Palmeiras Abel Ferreira was self-critical after losing the Brasileirão.

siete.titulo: Medina confident six days before the final
siete.texto: In an interview published by CONMEBOL, the Cacique highlighted his team's emotional character and sounded confident for Saturday at the Centenario.

siete.titulo: A self-critical Abel already thinking about the Pincha
siete.texto: After the 1-1 with Flamengo cost them the Brasileirão, Abel Ferreira listed the Verdão's mistakes and warned that his team "will fight to be champions" of South America. Murilo, Piquerez and Paulinho remain doubts, and on Tuesday 24th they visit Chapecoense.

siete.titulo: Copa Sudamericana 2027 secured, with the Recopa up for grabs
siete.texto: With Boca's Copa Sudamericana title, Estudiantes already have a place in the Copa Sudamericana 2027. If they win the final in Montevideo, next year they play the Copa Libertadores and also the Recopa Sudamericana against Boca.

siete.titulo: The road map to the Centenario
siete.texto: After Sunday off, the squad return to training tomorrow, Monday, in City Bell. On Wednesday 25th they travel to Montevideo (staying at the Hilton) and on Thursday and Friday they will train at Montevideo City Torque's training ground.

siete.titulo: Without Baltasar, Medina searches for his last starter
siete.texto: Baltasar Rodríguez, sent off against Flamengo, will miss the final. According to Diario Hoy, Fabricio Pérez is the leading option to replace him, with Eric Meza and Tomás Palacios as alternatives; El Día suggests repeating the back five used at the Maracanã.

siete.titulo: Around 35,000 Pincha fans head for Montevideo
siete.texto: 120 coaches are going: 60 laid on by the club, leaving the UNO on the afternoon of Friday 27th, and 60 from supporters' groups and branches. Friday and Saturday ferries are sold out, and 2009 champions invited by the club will also be at the Centenario.

Bilardo, Simeone, Sabella, Domínguez and Medina: José Sosa has played under all of them at the Pincha. The most decorated player in the club's history, a champion with Simeone, Domínguez and Medina, goes for another cup on Saturday.

linea.texto: A day off, back to City Bell on Monday and the trip to Montevideo: the Pincha's final week.
Abel Ferreira looks ahead to the final: "Our team will fight to be champions".
Medina in an interview with CONMEBOL: the team's emotion and his confidence for the final.
From Bilardo to Medina: the five managers Sosa has had at Estudiantes.
With a goal from Ascacíbar, Boca won the Copa Sudamericana and put the Pincha into the 2027 edition.
Palmeiras drew 1-1 with Flamengo, who are crowned Brasileirão champions.
"Close your eyes and believe": the poster campaign building up to the final on the streets.
La Plata's walls woke up plastered with Pincha legends.
Medina looks ahead to the final: "When our emotions are running high, we usually play well".
Rojo and González Pirez, a week from the final: "We have the match of our lives ahead of us".
Estudiantes de la Patria: the final also breaks the Argentina-Brazil tie in the all-time standings.
Palmeiras set to rest starters against Flamengo: Murilo in transition, Piquerez and Paulinho in treatment.
